description: context-os: keeps each architecture map's staleness flag honest (flips a map to DRIFTED when a source file in its folder changes), logs map-vs-source use per session so delivered savings can be measured (not guessed), gently points at a folder's map when the session reaches for source instead, and warns once as the conversation gets long enough that re-reading it dominates the cost. Never blocks a tool call; warnings live inside the map file and in a one-line note.
